newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends flat to higher on spillover.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends flat to higher on spillover.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled steady to higher on spillover support from firmness in CBOT and KCBT wheat, traders said.
Both KCBT and CBOT wheat gained in part due to concerns over dry weather in western Kansas.
"It was pretty quiet all session. We basically followed Kansas City. There was some light commercial buying early in the day but it was never anything heavy-duty," a trader said.
MGE spring wheat settled unchanged to four cents higher, with July up four cents at $4.15-1/4 per bushel. New-crop September settled up 2-3/4 cents at $4.12-1/2.
Traders said Cargill Investor Services bought MGE Sept spring wheat on the intermarket spread with KCBT wheat.
